notes.text: Semantic search: sender, date, attachment and other chips also filter the messages found by meaning
Removing a chip in the search also removes its words from the search field
Reading aloud starts sooner: a long first sentence is split at a comma
Reading aloud switched to the phone's voice while NovaBird Helper was still starting its voice
Search waited up to half a minute while the phone was computing vectors
Vectors of deleted messages stayed in the index
Phishing warning banners are readable in dark mode
